    Regular lifts of cyclic projectives #

    "At projective labels the modules are e_xA^{(4)}."

    If a graded module M over Λ is cyclic projective, M ≅ e Λ through a generator u and an inverse ψ, and e = π ẽ for an idempotent ẽ of Λ̃, then every lift M̃ of M is ẽΛ̃ through the generator w = ũ ẽ (exists_act_w, eq_zero_of_act_w), with inverse ψ̃ lifting ψ (ψO).

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.WLift.four_smul' {N : Type u_5} [AddCommGroup N] [Module (ZMod 4) N] (m : N) :
    2 • 2 • m = 0
